item.title: 📍 'The most important thing is that all the guys are alive' Dnepropetrovsk direction
item.description: 'The most important thing is that all the guys are alive' 📍 Dnepropetrovsk direction ➡️ A mobile medical group of the 341st Separate Medical Battalion of the Tsentr Group of Forces operates close to the front line. It is a high-tech field hub where wounded servicemen are provided with qualified medical care. 📌 A key advantage of this location is the ability to comply with the rule of the 'golden hour'. This is time of high importance after the wound, when doctors' actions are most effective. 💬 Battalion commander Alfir Talipov emphasises that it is the cohesion and precise work of the medics on the front line that makes it possible to rescue the servicemen: 'At the following stages, medical equipment is improved, and manpower is developed. The experience is great. Sometimes, wounded patients arrive and don't need anything redone because everything was properly handled at the previous stage. We take care, give food and water, stabilise, and send'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Today, during the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against facilities of the port and railway infrastructure, a
item.description: ❗️ Today, during the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against facilities of the port and railway infrastructure, as well as against vessels used to support of the AFU. As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit : ▪️ a dry cargo ship at sea, carrying military cargo to the port of Odessa; ▪️ a railway locomotive in the area of the Krivoy Rog railway station, used for transporting cargo used for the AFU. ▪️ In addition, three PS‑330 power substations were damaged in the cities of Rovno and Grabov in Rovno region, Kamenskoye in Dnepropetrovsk region, as well as one PS‑110 power substation in the city of Chernovtsy in Chernovtsy region. These substations ensure the distribution of electricity for the operation of enterprises of the Ukraine’s defence industry and logistics centres used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🏗 From airfields to recreational centres: how Russian military bases abroad updated
item.description: From airfields to recreational centres: how Russian military bases abroad updated Deputy Defence Minister of the Russian Federation Lieutenant General Pavel Fradkov inspected the development of the infrastructure of Russian military bases in the Republic of Kyrgyzstan and the Republic of Tajikistan. 🏗 Lieutenant General Pavel Fradkov inspected the development of airfield infrastructure and social facilities at the 999th Guard Air Base. Specialists of the Military Construction Complex reported on the implementation of the development plan at the airbase. 🏛 In the Republic of Tajikistan, on the territory of the 201st Russian military base, the construction of a cultural and leisure centre for servicemen and their families has been completed. The Deputy Defence Minister of the Russian Federation has ordered to complete the construction of a new modern canteen for military personnel by the end of the year. 🏋️ In the area of the 1109th optical-electronic hub, construction of a cultural and leisure centre has also been completed. It is planned to be opened immediately after the delivery of sports equipment. 📋 Following the working visit, Lieutenant General Pavel Fradkov gave a series of instructions for the implementation of plans to develop military and military social infrastructure. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
▫️
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
In Kharkov region, Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades and an assault regiment of the AFU close to Podsredneye, Novoselovka, and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region,
the Group's units inflicted losses on formations of two motorised infantry brigades, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a national guard close to Nikolayevka, Bititsa, and Krasnopolye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 175 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 16 motor vehicles, two electronic warfare stations, and one counter-fire radar station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian units engaged manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Monachinovka, Izyum, Novonikolayevka, and Petrovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 230 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 24 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade, and two assault regiments of the AFU near Krasny Molochar, Druzhkovka, and Nikolayevka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 180 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 26 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
💥
The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out intensive offensive operations.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade, an airborne brigade, an air assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, three national guard brigades, and a special forces brigade close to Novopavlovka, Krivorozhye, Sergeyevka, Novokrivorozhye, Sofiyevka, Svyatogorovka, Mikhailovka (Donetsk People's Republic), and Novopodgorodnoye (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 340 troops, eight armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and four electronic warfare stations.
